goal: Prevent nodes from spuriously disconnecting peers during block downloads over slow connections
Stop the ping timeout from dropping peers that prioritize sending blocks over answering pings
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by throttled bandwidth regtest simulation to confirm blocks complete without disconnect (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Code review approval with a minor suggestion to remove a redundant test assertion (fjahr)
Concept approval without stated reasons (l0rinc, danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because peers on slow links can hit the 20-minute ping timeout and drop despite behaving correctly
Improves peer connection stability and prevents wasted download bandwidth during block sync
